About The Album
Bedtime Stories: The Untold Chapter is an upcoming extended play by American singer-songwriter Madonna, set to be released on November 28, 2025, through Warner Records. The release commemorates the 30th anniversary of her sixth studio album, Bedtime Stories (1994). The EP "trace the evolution of Bedtime Stories' lush, R&B-influenced sound".

Tracklist
1. Survival (Quiet Storm Demo Remix)
2. Secret (Allstar New Single Mix)
3. Right On Time (Original Demo Edit)
4. Don’t Stop (Original Demo Edit)
5. Freedom (Short Mix)
6. Human Nature (Howie Tee New Clean Edit)
7. Let Down Your Guard (Rough Single Mix)
8. Love Won’t Wait (Original Demo Edit)
